item.title: 'American Scoundrel' traces Roy Cohn's playbook from McCarthyism to Trump
item.description: In Kai Bird's biography of Cohn, he looks at how the lawyer taught Trump how to deny, delay, attack, sue and countersue, never admit defeat, side-step paying bills and avoid a paper trail.
item.content:encoded: In Kai Bird's biography of Cohn, he looks at how the lawyer taught Trump how to deny, delay, attack, sue and countersue, never admit defeat, side-step paying bills and avoid a paper trail.
item.dc:creator: Terry Gross

item.title: D.C. airspace is complicated. Experts say Trump's arch would add one more risk
item.description: The Trump administration wants to build its 250-foot arch near one of the country's busiest runways. The FAA will determine whether that poses a hazard. But independent experts already have concerns.
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration wants to build its 250-foot arch near one of the country's busiest runways. The FAA will determine whether that poses a hazard. But independent experts already have concerns.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Treisman

item.title: Head Start got her out of homelessness. Trump proposal threatens that help for others
item.description: A Trump administration proposal would change access to Head Start for children experiencing homelessness and the kind of care they would receive if they do get in.

item.title: People's houses are collapsing into the ocean. FEMA gives them no other option
item.description: Waterfront homes are collapsing along the coast. Homeowners generally have plenty of warning before their house buckles. So why aren't most houses removed, or at least emptied, before they fall?

item.title: Pediatricians raise the alarm on the effect of Trump's immigration crackdown on kids
item.description: The Trump administration has been pursuing a quiet immigration crackdown strategy: limiting access to health care and public services. The American Academy of Pediatrics is sounding the alarm about the impact on children.

item.title: 4 measles-associated deaths reported in Pennsylvania amid outbreak
item.description: There have been four measles-associated deaths in Pennsylvania this summer amid a growing outbreak in the state.

item.title: A law requiring U.S.-made materials is slowing the construction of affordable homes
item.description: A law requires builders to use American-made construction materials if they want to get certain federal funds. It's slowing affordable housing construction.
item.content:encoded: A law requires builders to use American-made construction materials if they want to get certain federal funds. It's slowing affordable housing construction.

item.title: Why people are leaving entire houses to fall into the ocean
item.description: NPR dug into the upside-down world of FEMA flood insurance in coastal areas, and found many homeowners have no financial choice but to let their homes collapse.

item.title: House holds billionaire Leon Black in contempt of Congress over Epstein investigation
item.description: Billionaire investor Leon Black refused to appear before the committee investigating convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein for a deposition. Now it's up to the Department of Justice whether to pursue criminal charges.
